messages:
emma: Morning team 1 1 quick sync on the GenFlow Labs case study. They sent edits and want an embargo tied to next Wed's webinar. Need legal + signed release to proceed.

ryan: Can you paste their redlines? I'll start the launch post draft and slide frames.

jules-cs: Pasted from their doc: "Please remove specific throughput and cost figures. Shorten the quote to one sentence and include a brief privacy blurb about no customer data being retained."

heather-legal: That's acceptable. We need the signed release and a confirmation from their counsel on the final one-line quote (they said they can initial by EOD tomorrow). Also: add our standard logo-usage clause.

design: For slides we'll use an anonymized trend line with no axis labels and caption: "Representative improvement; specific metrics withheld at customer's request."

assets-bot: Asset checklist: headshot (3000px), logo (svg + png), 1-line bio, approved quote card (short), slides (png + pptx), social thumbnail 1200x628. Upload to /shared/marketing/assets/genflow/.

emma: Draft hero headline: "How GenFlow Labs accelerated inference and unlocked faster model iteration with Redwood Inference" (avoid % or raw numbers). Thoughts?

ryan: Good. Draft subhead: "A bioinformatics platform reduced serving friction and broadened production experiments." Placeholder: "{APPROVED_QUOTE}"  GenFlow Labs.

jules-cs: I talked to the customer. Proposed one-line quote: "Redwood Inference reduced serving friction and let our team iterate on models faster." They like the privacy blurb too.

heather-legal: Redwood side can approve the wording once we have the executed release and the customer's counsel initial on the quote. Keep the internal benchmark appendix marked INTERNAL ONLY.

jules-cs: Uploaded signed release to drive and cc'd customer counsel; they initialed the quote line in the doc.

emma: Great. Timeline if everything is in by EOD today:
- Thu 23:59 PT: embargoed publish into queue
- Fri AM: go live + announce + kickoff webinar promotion for next week

design: Will deliver hero slide + one customer highlight card by Thu morning. No numbers anywhere.

ryan: I'll post the launch post draft and slide text here tonight for a quick review.

emma: Thanks all  let's keep the copy tight and privacy-forward. Ping here once assets land. :thumbsup:
